chunks: But those who are pious and obedient to their Lord, will have gardens with streams of running water where they will abide as guests of God; and what is with God is best for the pious.

key_terms.تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ: Streams of running water beneath them

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for the pious (muttaqun) according to Surah Aal-Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the superiority of divine proximity (qurb) over material rewards, emphasizing that what is 'with Allah'—specifically the vision of the Divine and eternal nearness to the Ahl al-Bayt—surpasses all earthly delights. The term 'al-abrar' is often interpreted to refer specifically to the Imams and the righteous followers who embody true piety through their adherence to divine commandments. This contrast serves as a spiritual incentive for believers to cultivate taqwa not merely for reward, but for the ultimate satisfaction of being in God's presence.
